verdict.rationale: n8n documents Git-based version control: it is listed as a plan feature, and there is a source-control-and-environments docs page for pushing and pulling changes. This covers the versioning part of the story. The evidence is only feature titles, and it never describes a review workflow such as diffs or approvals, or a rollback to a prior version. Missing for 10: documented review/diff or approval of workflow changes, documented rollback/restore to previous versions, details of the Git workflow beyond page titles, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
